title: Copied catalog prefix
statement: For Boolean words $w$ and $x$, and every $i \le |x|$, after $i$ steps the catalog-prefix machine initialized with state $|w|$, input-head position $1$, and output $w$ is in state $|w|$, has input-head position $i+1$, and has output $w$ followed by the first $i$ symbols of $x$.
